analysis.is_complaint_reason: Customer expresses dissatisfaction with branch staff conduct (sighing, eye-rolling, being told to use a machine) and says they felt humiliated, which is material distress under CH-1.
analysis.summary: Customer with a stammer visited the Kingsbridge Road branch on Friday to pay in cash for their business. They say the counter member of staff sighed, rolled his eyes, said 'I haven't got all day' and told them to use the machine instead, in front of a queue. The customer felt humiliated and wants an apology and staff training. They asked for contact by email only. Branch manager has been informed and a CCTV request (BR-2210) raised. Branch manager statement is pending. When asked on 2026-10-13, the customer said they did not need support and only wanted an apology.

timeline.event: Customer visited Kingsbridge Road branch to pay in cash for their business; staff member sighed, rolled eyes, said 'I haven't got all day' and told customer to use the machine
Branch manager informed; CCTV request raised (BR-2210); customer asked by email whether support was needed and said no; email-only contact flagged on account

analysis.severity_reason: Complaint about staff conduct is Medium under CH-6. No financial loss alleged. Customer reports distress from being humiliated in public. Not High, as no vulnerability risk of harm was identified by the customer.

vulnerability.suggested_support: Customer has a stammer, which may affect how they communicate in branch and on the phone. Keep email-only contact as flagged. Allow extra time for written responses and do not reply by phone. Customer said no support needed on 2026-10-13, but record that the offer was made and reconfirm if they raise further issues.

analysis.routing_reason: No ESC-1 trigger identified: this is a staff conduct complaint with no fraud, lending, vulnerability referral (no VUL-4 factors such as financial difficulty, health risk to wellbeing, abuse or bereavement), systemic issue, legal threat, media contact or systems fault. Complaints handler can resolve. Reconsider if the branch manager statement or CCTV reveals a wider issue.
